schmidt.convention: psi = c|00> + s|11>, k = c/s <= 1 canonical (the k <-> 1/k mirror ties, EQ5)

optimizer.parameters: theta (Schmidt angle), alpha0, alpha1, beta0, beta1
optimizer.penalty: p_Hardy - lambda * sum_i P_i^2 over the three zero-constraint probabilities
optimizer.polish: constraint-eliminated envelope p_env(k), golden-section in k to 1e-12
optimizer.me_slice: constraint-eliminated p(k=1, a): 1000-point grid in log10 a in [-3, 3] plus Nelder-Mead polish in a
